name: expo-ios-agents
description: Expo / React Native iOS with several coding agents on one Mac: the ios-q lane queue (build, boot, maestro, heavy, device) with waiting in line, a user-is-waiting priority, leases that end with their holder and admission by load and memory; one dev client per native fingerprint with JS through Metro; a leased pool of always-booted simulators; Jest first and Maestro as a tagged smoke set; the iPhone through devicectl; build caches across worktrees; a weekly disk sweep.
